messages:
sam.product: FYI — ACME Health reached out via sales. They want a pricing option: per-token reduction if they commit ~1.2B tokens/mo, plus a small reserved capacity cushion and ability to burst. Sales needs Product/FinOps guidance on packaging and launch criteria.

elena.sales: customer is medium-term runway, HIPAA scope, will sign if we can give ~20% off hosted per-token vs standard for that commit + burst credits. also cares about predictable spend, not just credits.

matt.finops: rough numbers — at 1.2B tokens/mo, 20% off hosted is material. we should propose: tiered commit (1B, 1.5B) with blended rate, and 10% burst credits included. need to know token mix (gen vs embed) to model.

julia.support: for HIPAA they want private or dedicated? they said VPC preferred but will accept Dedicated if SLA present. also asked about logging retention and audit export for 7 years. that impacts cost.

elena.sales: they're ok with Dedicated for first year if pricing works. main ask: 'show me a predictable monthly invoice under commit with an overage policy that's simple' — they dislike per-minute complexity.

sam.product: Proposal draft: 3-pack option
- Commit tiers: 0.8B / 1.2B / 2.0B tokens
- Blended per-token rate per tier (hosted) with a 15–22% discount band depending on tier
- Included burst cushion = 10% of commit per month (useable tokens)
- Overage: flat per-token overage rate 1.5x base blended rate (no hourly buckets)
- Dedicated option: equivalent effective price with a small fixed infra premium + 5% lower overage.

matt.finops: that looks sane. we should also show an example invoice calc. quick snippet for sales deck:

```
Commit: 1.2B tokens @ $0.0022/blended = $2,640/mo
Included burst (10%) = 120M tokens
Overage (if used) = tokens * $0.0033
```
estimate yearly with 10% churn buffer.

julia.support: from an ops perspective, add these as launch criteria:
- documentable SLA for Dedicated (99.9% monthly uptime)
- onboarding checklist for HIPAA (contracts, BAA, KMS config)
- audit export runbook + RBAC defaults

elena.sales: can we give a 30-day PoC credit bucket for them to validate? they'd like to run real traffic first.

sam.product: I think PoC credits OK but gate it: PoC max 20% of proposed monthly commit, must sign LOI to get pilot extension. Also need acceptance criteria: latency < 120ms p50 on typical gen workloads and no regression on hallucination evals across our standard prompt set.

matt.finops: agree. also flag for legal: long-term commit discount needs prepayment vs monthly invoices — which affects cashflow.

ops-bot: Reminder: create a product intake card in Jira and tag @eng-runtime and @eng-platform for Dedicated capacity feasibility.

sam.product: next steps: I'll make a concise 1-pager for sales with the three tiers, example invoice, PoC guardrails, and launch criteria. @elena.sales can you confirm customer's preferred tier and whether they need private deployment? once we have that, I'll open the intake card. :thumbsup:

elena.sales: will confirm today. thanks all. :raised_hands:
